changes_made.explanation: Added WikiSQL dataset mentioned in the paper and specified BERT-large based on explicit references. Removed generic BERT in favor of BERT-large which is explicitly mentioned. Note: WikiSQL is mentioned in the context of text-to-SQL research but not all experiments use it; keeping it as it's part of the research context.
Removed duplicate 'exact-match accuracy' and kept normalized 'Exact Match (EM)' as the primary metric name
Removed placeholder 'None' values as no LLM evaluation was conducted
Removed placeholder 'None' values as no human evaluation was conducted

overall_notes: The paper focuses on text-to-SQL generation with strong emphasis on model architecture comparisons and ablation studies. Evaluation is primarily through exact match accuracy on SQL queries. While structurally simpler than RAT-SQL, DuoRAT achieves comparable performance with faster training. The paper mentions other models and datasets in the research context but the core experiments focus on Spider dataset.
